newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Red Cross appeals for $8.2 mln Iran quake aid.
newsitem.headline: Red Cross appeals for $8.2 mln Iran quake aid.

text.p: The world Red Cross body appealed on Monday for $8.2 million for victims of Iran's killer quake.
The Geneva-based International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies said the appeal was on behalf of Iran's Red Crescent organisation to pay for vital relief supplies.

It added that a senior IFRC official would arrive in Tehran on Monday to help coordinate Red Cross relief efforts for victims of Saturday's earthquake in eastern Iran which killed nearly 2,400 people, measuring 7.1 on the Richter scale.
Iran has appealed for foreign aid to relieve suffering in the quake zone where thousands of people have been left homeless.
Quakes hit Iran regularly. The worst recorded one, measuring 7.3 on the Richter scale, killed some 35,000 people in 1990 in a densely populated region near the Caspian Sea coast.
